name: The substitute (badal)
definition: A follower that stands in for the word before it and is the one really meant, taking all of its iʿrāb.
body: Four kinds: the thing for the thing (jāʾanī zaydun akhūka, Zayd, your brother), the part for the whole (akaltu al-raghīfa thuluthahu, the loaf, a third of it), inclusion (nafaʿanī zaydun ʿilmuhu, Zayd, his knowledge), and the slip (raʾaytu zaydan al-farasa: you meant to say 'the horse' and said 'Zayd' by mistake).
In the part and inclusion kinds the substitute carries a pronoun that goes back to the first word (-hu).

examples.text: Zayd, your brother, came to me.
I ate the loaf, a third of it (al-Ājurrūmiyya).
